items.title: Every pro-etale covering of an object of the big pro-etale site is refined by a covering of the site
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that every pro-etale covering of an object of a big pro-etale site is refined by a covering in the site (statement lines 6515-6523). The proof (proof lines 6525-6534) covers the object by spectra of w-contractible rings, uses the refinement property of those to split the induced coverings into finitely many open pieces, and collects them into the required covering. H2: a three-step refinement with two inputs, written out in full.
